term.loan.name: Loan
term.loan.simple: Money you borrow and must pay back.
term.loan.life: Borrowing ₹6,000 from a bank to buy a phone.
term.loan.real: Loan = borrowed money that is repaid over time, usually with interest.
term.principal.name: Principal
term.principal.simple: The amount you borrowed, before any interest.
term.principal.life: You borrow ₹6,000. That ₹6,000 is the principal.
term.principal.real: Principal = the original amount borrowed or deposited, before interest.
term.interestRate.name: Interest rate
term.interestRate.simple: The yearly price of borrowing, as a percent.
term.interestRate.life: 18% a year on a loan means about ₹18 a year for every ₹100 you still owe.
term.interestRate.real: Interest rate = the percent charged on money owed (or paid on money saved) for one year. Written as % p.a.
term.tenure.name: Tenure
term.tenure.simple: How long a loan or a deposit runs.
term.tenure.life: A phone loan repaid over 6 months has a tenure of 6 months.
term.tenure.real: Tenure = the length of time of a loan or a deposit.
term.emi.name: EMI
term.emi.simple: The same amount you pay every month to repay a loan.
term.emi.life: ₹1,053 a month for 6 months on a ₹6,000 loan.
term.emi.real: EMI = Equated Monthly Instalment: a fixed monthly payment that covers interest and part of the principal.
term.flatReducingRate.name: Flat and reducing rates
term.flatReducingRate.simple: Two ways of charging interest. Flat costs more.
term.flatReducingRate.life: "Flat 9%" charges on the full loan all year. "9% reducing" charges only on what is still owed.
term.flatReducingRate.real: Flat rate = interest on the full principal for the whole tenure. Reducing rate = interest only on the balance still owed.
term.processingFee.name: Processing fee
term.processingFee.simple: A fee a lender charges to set up a loan.
term.processingFee.life: A ₹300 fee taken out before a ₹3,000 loan reaches you.
term.processingFee.real: Processing fee = a one-time charge for giving a loan. It adds to the cost of borrowing.
term.noCostEmi.name: No-cost EMI
term.noCostEmi.simple: An EMI plan that says it charges no interest.
term.noCostEmi.life: Six payments of ₹1,000 for a phone that costs ₹5,500 in cash.
term.noCostEmi.real: No-cost EMI = instalments with no stated interest. The cost can sit in a lost discount or a fee, so compare the total with the cash price.
term.creditLimit.name: Credit limit
term.creditLimit.simple: The most you can borrow on a card.
term.creditLimit.life: A card with a ₹10,000 limit will not let you spend ₹12,000.
term.creditLimit.real: Credit limit = the maximum amount a lender lets you owe on a credit card at one time.
term.minimumDue.name: Minimum due
term.minimumDue.simple: The smallest payment that avoids a late fee.
term.minimumDue.real: Minimum due = the least you must pay by the due date. Interest is charged on whatever you leave unpaid.
term.creditScore.name: Credit score
term.creditScore.simple: A number that shows how reliably you repay.
term.creditScore.life: Two people ask for the same loan and are offered different rates.
term.creditScore.real: Credit score = a number built from your repayment record. Lenders use it to decide whether to lend, how much, and at what rate.
term.utilisation.name: Utilisation
term.utilisation.simple: How much of your credit limit you are using.
term.utilisation.real: Utilisation = amount owed ÷ credit limit. Lower is seen as safer by lenders.
term.billingCycle.name: Billing cycle
term.billingCycle.simple: The month of card spending that one bill covers.
term.interestFreePeriod.name: Interest-free period
term.interestFreePeriod.simple: The time between a purchase and the bill's due date, if you pay the bill in full.
term.lateFee.name: Late fee
term.lateFee.simple: A charge for paying after the due date.
term.bnpl.name: Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL)
term.bnpl.simple: A way to take something now and pay in parts later. It is borrowing.
term.nbfc.name: NBFC
term.nbfc.simple: A Non-Banking Financial Company: a regulated lender that is not a bank.
term.collateral.name: Collateral
term.collateral.simple: Something a lender can take if you do not repay.
term.coSigning.name: Co-signing
term.coSigning.simple: Agreeing to repay someone else's loan if they do not.
term.moneylender.name: Moneylender
term.moneylender.simple: A person who lends informally, often at a very high rate and with no paperwork.
